description: Header file defining functions related to WPA Supplicant in a WiFi generation plugin, including initialization, cleanup, daemon control, configuration writing, and status checks.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_init
methods.description: Initializes WPA Supplicant module for a given endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources for WPA Supplicant associated with a given endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_startDaemon
methods.description: Starts the WPA Supplicant daemon for the specified endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_stopDaemon
methods.description: Stops the WPA Supplicant daemon for the specified endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_reloadDaemon
methods.description: Reloads or restarts the WPA Supplicant daemon for the specified endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes configuration for the WPA Supplicant.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the WPA Supplicant daemon is currently running for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the WPA Supplicant process is alive.
